name: Bloodmage Lynnore
summary: Bloodmage Lynnore is a blood elf practitioner of forbidden blood magic camped with her brother Drazial near the northern entrance to the Blasted Lands. She assists adventurers by concocting potent alchemical draughts from the organs of local beasts.

sections.title: Master of Blood Magic
sections.body: Camped near the northern entrance to the Blasted Lands alongside her brother Drazial, Bloodmage Lynnore is one of the exceptionally rare elven practitioners of blood magic found in the Eastern Kingdoms. Unperturbed by the harsh and corrupting landscape of the Blasted Lands, she studies the latent arcane and vital energies coursing through native beasts. Travelers who bring her the brains and gizzards of local fauna find that she can distill these gruesome reagents into specialized elixirs granting profound enhancements to intellect and spirit.

faq.answer: Bloodmage Lynnore is a blood elf blood mage camped near the northern entrance to the Blasted Lands. She serves as a quest giver and alchemical specialist, offering powerful stat-enhancing concoctions in exchange for beast parts.

faq.q: Where can Bloodmage Lynnore be found?
faq.answer: She makes her camp with her brother, Bloodmage Drazial, near the northern entrance to the Blasted Lands, where the pass from the Swamp of Sorrows opens onto the wastes.

Lynnore uses parts scavenged from the local wildlife—such as basilisk brains, vulture gizzards, and snickerfang jowls—to brew rare tonics like the Cerebral Cortex Compound and Gizzard Gum, which grant prolonged enhancements to intellect and spirit.

angles.text: Lynnore acts as a valuable tactical contact in the Blasted Lands, trading unique alchemical reagents and offering dark arcane expertise to advance Horde power against local demonic threats.
For mages fascinated by unconventional spellcraft, Lynnore represents an elusive and controversial branch of arcane philosophy that manipulates vital essence rather than conventional ley energies.
